text:
# n7. Whole-original decision, unresolved proof coverage, and deliverables

Use qualified G331 and n1--n6. The ENTIRE original P12.4 is NOT solved by this manuscript; candidate=false. This last note makes no complete-solution claim. The positive results and gaps are separated below so that a reviewer can use the partial mathematics without importing a false product theorem.

What is established in the draft proof chain is: an unconditional mixed-multiplicity kernel at every excellent reduced local ring, a unique finite positive moment-measure extension to every real $C$ tuple and every bounded input in the ACTUAL decreasing completion $D$, a weak descending-net theorem whose specified limit belongs to that domain, exact primary-gauge and normalization identities for that construction, and identification with the exact published BFJ operator in its smooth affine CLOSED-germ algebraically closed characteristic-zero range. Every semivaluation support and full conductor fibre is retained. Inputs with zero or mixed-zero coordinates are not excluded; unbounded and bottom inputs are outside this bounded construction. Non-equidimensional rings use the explicitly stated degree-$n$ convention and $n-1$ potential slots.

There is also an actual geometric result for all excellent reduced curves: the zero-potential reference measure (5), independent Cartier degree comparison (6)--(7) on actual primary models for real presentations, model independence, primary-gauge and normalization rules with actual residue-degree weights, and open-set locality and bounded continuity for that zero-arity operator. Dimension zero has the empty-boundary zero measure. N6 supplies a genuine nilpotent-data obstruction and an exact non-equidimensional degeneracy, with their limited conclusions stated.

Two essential higher-dimensional geometric obligations remain unresolved:

1. For every actual negative curve-nef REAL Cartier presentation on an actual primary blowup, prove that the scalar kernel extension is its independent local Cartier intersection, with all nonnormal, non-Cohen--Macaulay, finite-residue-field and non-equidimensional issues handled. In particular, the real $C$ comparison supplied by G331 is a FUNCTION approximation theorem, not an INTERSECTION-continuity theorem. Knowing that section ideals approximate the evaluation uniformly does not prove their multiplicities converge to an independently defined Euler-characteristic intersection. No arbitrary-model cofinality is available. A correct projection and independent-intersection argument on these primary models must be supplied.

2. Prove actual locality on open regions: if each pair $u_i,w_i$ of bounded geometric inputs agrees on an open $U\subset X_{\mathfrak a}$, prove equality of the restrictions of their mixed measures to $U$. Global length polynomials, positivity on tests, uniqueness of moment representation, and weak limits do not establish this. The finite toy diagnostic in n6 shows the general logical implication is false. Even a localized atom formula for core inputs would require a further passage to arbitrary bounded completed inputs; no such passage has been proved here. BFJ Section 4 supplies its exact smooth construction/comparison/continuity, not a singular arbitrary-characteristic locality grant.

Therefore n3's measures are called moment measures, not claimed to be P12.4's actual geometric products. Their algebraic presentation independence must not be relabelled as geometric model-independent intersection theory. The exact full original is left open in dimension at least two. No general obstruction to the reduced target has been proved; missing proof is not impossibility. The nilpotent example obstructs only a boundary-only unreduced multiplicity reconstruction. P12.5 and general P12.6 remain separate.

The fresh deliverables are P12.4-paper.tex/PDF, argument.md, source-application-ledger.md, exact-scope.md, whole-proof-coverage.md, original-scope-and-noncircularity-decision.md, native-notes.json, n1.md through n7.md, bounded-evidence-input.json, exact_diagnostics.py, audit_inputs.py, build_delivery.py, and final_audit.py. Exact bound mathematical/primary source bodies and manifests are retained under inputs; reports retain their URLs, original/local paths, hashes, declared reading units, environment details, finite evidence and build results. The incoming qualified G331 source, mandatory annotation and source ledger are copied unchanged. No attached/source/ROOT program was executed or imported. No active private campaign output or hot feedback was read.

Rerun from this directory: `python audit_inputs.py`; `python exact_diagnostics.py`; `python build_delivery.py`; `python final_audit.py`. Compilation uses pdflatex with no shell escape. All scripts are freshly owned and execute only the declared small local tasks. No supervised heavy-compute service was supplied or needed. No agents, authentication/runtime/environment/HOME/CODEX_HOME/proxy/CA changes, publication, catalogue changes, or protected editor interactions were used. No tool output is treated as mathematical verification. The caller's requested model name is not an independently measured execution attestation.

The final audit checks file/support/hash consistency only. Every paper claim remains an unverified mathematical draft. The candidate flag remains false specifically because independent higher-dimensional Cartier comparison and locality are not proved; artifact completeness and a successful build cannot change that decision.
